messages.author: 5865ad824030260e
messages.subject: haploid
parts:
I am analyzing a cross between 2 haploid organisms (P falciparum)
I am pretending it is a BC, as all individuals are haploid, will it be  
the best option?

also, my data in in bp , so i get a warning :
In summary.cross(cross) :
   Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with  
the genetic map.
   (Perhaps it is in basepairs?)

Do i need to tell it is in bp? how can I pass it to cM?

Thanks

susana

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] haploid
parts:
treating it as a backcross is the best you can do.

Convert the distances to Mbp and then use est.map and replace.map to estimate and use the genetic map.  

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] kb/cM
parts:

karl
